title: 圈地之王国际版（King of Land Enclosure）
description:
中文：
在游戏中，玩家通过移动角色画出路径，当路径闭合形成封闭区域时，该区域即被占领。过程中需注意避开对手的路径或利用策略切断对方路线，增加了竞技的策略性和趣味性。适合喜欢轻度对抗、快节奏游戏的玩家，支持多人联机模式，可与好友实时对战，体验协作与竞争的乐趣。
English：
In the game, players draw paths by moving their characters. When a closed loop forms, the enclosed area is claimed. Players must avoid opponents' paths or strategically block their routes, adding competitive strategy and fun. Suitable for those who enjoy light competition and fast-paced gameplay, the game supports multiplayer modes, allowing real-time battles with friends to experience both collaboration and rivalry.
